Ines has captained the Brinemoor Tide Wardens for six years with half the wardens
she needs. In September she found harbor office clearances for three night sailings
that no warden on watch saw leave, the *Merrow's Luck* among them. She suspects
someone in the harbor office but cannot prove it, and she will not move on the town's
favorite clerk without proof.

## Common knowledge

Captain of the Tide Wardens. Fair, by most accounts, and hard. The town respects her
more than it likes her.
